findings.category: data-integrity / revision race across worker restart
findings.title: Revision restarts at 0 after worker restart; expected_revision can approve a document that silently lost applied edits
findings.description: After restart _doc_call silently reopens original at revision 0; revision numbers repeat; expected_revision None skips check.
findings.exploit_scenario: Edit A (rev1) -> malicious page forces timeout/restart -> reopen rev0 -> edit B -> export with expected_revision=1 succeeds without A.
findings.recommendation: Mark document reset after restart: fail later calls (REVISION_CONFLICT/WORKER_FAILED) until explicit reopen, or epoch; make expected_revision mandatory for plan/apply/export.

findings.title: _shared_stream misses same-page duplicate /Contents entries and Form-XObject/annotation-AP reuse of the target content stream
findings.description: _shared_stream only scans other pages' /Contents. (a) the same stream listed twice in the target page's /Contents (interpreter executes each entry; two TextRuns share stream/op_index; different fonts possible) and (b) the page content stream also referenced as a Form XObject (Do) or annotation /AP are not detected; _rewrite rewrites the shared instruction in place so every other drawing changes; content_diff only diffs /Contents so (b) is not reported.
findings.exploit_scenario: Page-1 content stream also used as Form XObject on page 3 (or listed twice on page 1 under different CTM/font); editing a word on page 1 silently changes page 3 / the second instance (possibly garbage glyphs).
findings.recommendation: Count all references to the target stream objgen (all pages' /Contents including same page, /XObject resources recursively, annotation /AP); refuse SHARED_RESOURCE_UNSAFE if >1, or copy-on-write the stream.

findings.title: Failed apply_edit leaves the working document half-edited (stream/resources mutated before checks); later export/commit includes it
findings.description: _rewrite mutates page Resources (mode B) and writes the stream before ActualText sync check and before all _rewrite_op checks; no rollback; server keeps document; export_document serializes dirty pike. Direct (non-indirect) ActualText holder gives objgen (0,0) and fails after rewrite.
findings.exploit_scenario: Tagged PDF with direct struct element holding /ActualText: apply rewrites content then fails; user exports -> new glyphs with old /ActualText.
findings.recommendation: Make apply transactional (validate all first, or snapshot working bytes and restore on exception); reject non-indirect holder in tagged.py.

findings.title: Mode A pure insertion at end of TJ inserts after trailing TJ numbers, diverging from planned geometry (TEXT_OVERFLOW bypass)
findings.description: For g0==len(glyphs) the plan's start = last glyph origin + advance (ignores trailing TJ number) but _rewrite_op replace sets lo=hi=len(tokens), placing new glyphs after trailing numbers; mode B uses positions[-1]+1 correctly.
findings.exploit_scenario: [(Amount:) -60000] TJ; appending text: plan reports in-region, glyphs drawn ~60 em away.
findings.recommendation: Insert at positions[-1]+1 when g0==len(positions) (match split_b); regression test with trailing TJ number.

findings.category: integrity: wrong glyph rendered while mode A reports success
findings.title: Mode A selects codes from attacker /ToUnicode and checks glyphs via a mapping different from the renderer's
findings.description: encode reverse-maps ToUnicode only; single-byte TrueType glyph lookup uses (3,1)+ToUnicode char; base14 has_glyph/width use ToUnicode char not /Encoding; Type0 accepts any outlined CID regardless of which character it draws.
findings.exploit_scenario: ToUnicode maps code 0x31->'9'; editing 100->900 emits 0x31 rendered as '1'; plan/extraction say 900, viewers show 100.
findings.recommendation: Derive code->glyph like the renderer (Encoding/Differences->glyph name->cmap/post; CIDToGIDMap/charset) and require ToUnicode to agree with an independent source; refuse mode A on disagreement.

findings.category: integrity / check bypass (assistive-tech text retains old content)
findings.title: Alt/E/ActualText check trusts /ParentTree and /P back-links, which can disagree with the /K tree
findings.description: Element found only via ParentTree; climbs attacker-controlled /P; no verification that element's /K lists the MCID or chain reaches StructTreeRoot. (a) ParentTree points to decoy element without /Alt while real /K owner has /Alt/ActualText; (b) leaf /P null -> real ancestor with /Alt never examined. Negative MCID indexes from end. No ADR-0017 post-save validation in product code.
findings.exploit_scenario: /P element with /Alt containing old name/ID owns MCID 0 in /K; ParentTree maps MCID 0 to orphan /Span; edit succeeds, /Alt still has old text.
findings.recommendation: Cross-validate ParentTree element lists the MCID in /K and /P chain consistent with /K up to StructTreeRoot; reject negative MCID; ideally walk /K from root collecting all covering elements; add post-save checks.

findings.title: Duplicate MCID in holder /K: only last copy rewritten, old text remains in /ActualText
findings.description: _mcids_under does not dedupe; covered=[5,5] doubles text and offset overwritten to last copy; ActualText 'OLDOLD' passes equality; result 'OLDNEW'.
findings.exploit_scenario: /Span /K [0 0] with doubled ActualText; edit reports ActualText synced but old text remains.
findings.recommendation: Reject duplicate MCIDs in covered list (UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE); verify after sync that old text no longer present / equality with new content.

findings.title: Main process uses worker results without schema validation; worker keys override main-process report fields
findings.description: KeyError/TypeError tracebacks; {**exported} lets worker override source_sha256; output_hash trusted from worker.
findings.exploit_scenario: Compromised worker forges validation.json attesting clean export.
findings.recommendation: Schema-validate results (WORKER_FAILED on mismatch); main-process fields last/nested; compute output_hash in main process.

findings.category: sensitive data exposure in sidecar output
findings.title: edit-text writes removed original text in plaintext to plan.json/validation.json beside output
findings.description: plan contains old_text; validation content_changes contain old operator bytes; write_text follows symlinks/overwrites.
findings.exploit_scenario: Redacting an ID then sharing the output folder leaks the ID via plan.json/validation.json.
findings.recommendation: Omit old text/operands by default (hashes/lengths), opt-in flag; exclusive create for sidecars.

findings.title: export_document passes raw caller path to worker; spec §7 requires destination_token
findings.description: Worker writes to any .pdf path not existing (O_EXCL safe vs TOCTOU); no canonicalization, UNC/device not rejected; worker holds write authority.
findings.exploit_scenario: Future less-trusted caller or sandboxed worker could write to UNC share (outbound SMB) / device path.
findings.recommendation: Main process validates destination (reject UNC/device/\\?\, require existing parent) and writes bytes/temp itself (P3 transaction).

findings.title: Overflow check tests only baseline start/end; negative widths or Tc let intermediate glyphs leave the region
findings.description: new_adv sums attacker-controlled widths and Tc/Tw; only start and end points checked against region.
findings.exploit_scenario: Codes with alternating-sign advances: endpoints in mask, intermediate glyphs outside.
findings.recommendation: Check every cumulative glyph origin, or reject negative effective advances.

findings.title: _between_pieces checks nothing when runs come from different occurrences of the same stream or op_index not increasing
findings.description: Slice instructions[first.op_index+1 : last.op_index] empty if last<=first; same stream listed twice in /Contents allows cross-occurrence span.
findings.exploit_scenario: /Contents [S T S]: span across occurrences passes, edits delete glyphs in both occurrences.
findings.recommendation: Require same occurrence and strictly increasing op_index (or reject duplicate stream occurrences entirely, cf. F-01-01).

findings.title: Default allowed_change_mask covers whole target runs, not the selected glyphs
findings.description: _selection_box uses all glyph bboxes of each target run, so a longer replacement mid-run can overlap following text without TEXT_OVERFLOW when no editable_region is given.
findings.exploit_scenario: 'Pay to: ACME Ltd. Amount 100' single Tj; 100->100,000 overlaps following glyphs yet reported within mask.
findings.recommendation: Default region from glyphs [g0,g1) of change pieces only, or require editable_region.

findings.title: content_diff runs quadratic difflib over every content stream of every page
findings.description: SequenceMatcher autojunk=False on all pages incl. unedited; N identical ops -> O(N^2); MAX_CONTENT_OPERATORS not applied.
findings.exploit_scenario: Page 2 with 200k identical path ops -> every export times out.
findings.recommendation: Diff only streams whose decoded bytes differ; prefix/suffix trim; cap operator count (RESOURCE_LIMIT).

findings.title: Incremental check counts raw 'startxref' bytes; attacker bytes block every export
findings.description: data.count(b'startxref') != 1 matches bytes inside uncompressed/filtered stream data or Info strings.
findings.exploit_scenario: JPEG COM segment containing 'startxref' -> export always VALIDATION_FAILED.
findings.recommendation: Structural check: /Prev in trailer and single xref section (parse final startxref only).

findings.title: Export computes content/resource diffs but never checks them against the applied plans
findings.description: Write decision depends only on qpdf/incremental/unreachable/repair/page count; changes outside planned streams/ops/pages or undeclared resource changes are not rejected.
findings.exploit_scenario: With F-01-01 PDF, export reports ok while content_changes lists an unedited page.
findings.recommendation: Record expected change set per committed plan; VALIDATION_FAILED on any change outside it.

findings.title: Failed write leaves a partial PDF at the destination
findings.description: OSError during write/flush/fsync raises SAVE_FAILED without unlinking the partially written file (spec §7: no partial output); retry then blocked by 'exists'.
findings.exploit_scenario: Disk full mid-write leaves truncated PDF that may be mistaken for the saved document.
findings.recommendation: Write temp + fsync + exclusive rename (P3), or unlink destination on failure.

findings.title: Mode B ToUnicode keeps only the last character when two characters map to the same Noto glyph
findings.description: dict(zip(codes, text)) collapses distinct code points sharing a glyph.
findings.exploit_scenario: U+2F00 and U+4E00 in new text extract as the same character.
findings.recommendation: Detect conflicting duplicates; reject or give distinct codes.

findings.category: integrity: blank glyph accepted as present
findings.title: Outline check accepts composites/degenerate paths that render blank
findings.description: TrueType numberOfContours!=0 accepts composites with empty components; CFF calcBounds not None accepts zero-area paths.
findings.exploit_scenario: Subset keeps digits as composites to empty glyph; mode A succeeds, renders blank.
findings.recommendation: Require non-zero-area bounds after resolving composites (bounded).

findings.category: integrity: wrong glyph decision (CID vs GID)
findings.title: CID-keyed CFF with one ToUnicode code missing from charset falls back to code-as-GID
findings.description: by_index chosen for ROS fonts when any mapped code is not in charset; renderers use charset; also odd-length CIDToGIDMap last code reads 1 byte.
findings.exploit_scenario: Charset CIDs blank but same-numbered GIDs outlined; one bogus ToUnicode code forces GID interpretation; edit renders blank/.notdef.
findings.recommendation: Require charset for ROS fonts unless ALL mapped codes fail CID lookup and resolve by index consistently (justify P0 fixtures); treat odd-length CIDToGIDMap as malformed.

findings.title: calcBounds interprets attacker CFF charstrings with unbounded subroutine fan-out
findings.description: fontTools op_callsubr has no depth/operation limit; N^d fan-out per glyph; not cached; called per char per candidate code.
findings.exploit_scenario: CFF glyph calling 20-deep chain of subrs each calling next 4 times -> plan hangs until timeout.
findings.recommendation: Bounded custom charstring walker (depth<=10, op budget) or no interpretation; memoize per glyph.

findings.title: parse_cmap lazy regexes quadratic on unterminated beginbfchar/beginbfrange blocks (4 MiB cap still allows ~1e11 steps)
findings.description: re.findall(beginbfchar(.*?)endbfchar) with many begin tokens and no end scans to end each time; same for bfrange array pattern; runs during interpret() for every Tf. (Related to P1 F-022.)
findings.exploit_scenario: ToUnicode inflating to 4 MB of 'beginbfchar' with no terminator hangs page analysis until timeout; worker restart loses unsaved edits.
findings.recommendation: Linear tokenizer / str.find-based block scan; stop at first unterminated block; cap blocks.

findings.title: ToUnicode codes outside the font code space reach encode; plan ready but apply crashes
findings.description: parse_cmap accepts up to 4 hex digits for single-byte fonts and unbounded lo_i+i in bfrange array form; _regroup raises on >255 / >0xFFFF.
findings.exploit_scenario: Single-byte font ToUnicode <0141> <0041>; typing A gives ready mode A, apply -> WORKER_FAILED.
findings.recommendation: Drop codes outside code space (0-255 single-byte, 0-0xFFFF two-byte); bound array form by hi_i.

findings.title: ToUnicode/CIDToGIDMap/font programs fully decompressed before limits; CIDToGIDMap re-inflated per glyph check
findings.description: read_bytes before MAX_CMAP_BYTES; FontFile2/3 uncapped; glyph_name calls gid_map.read_bytes each call.
findings.exploit_scenario: Huge CIDToGIDMap re-inflated per character -> OOM/timeout.
findings.recommendation: Cache CIDToGIDMap bytes per checker; cap sizes (P7 for general decompression limits).
